status: Frozen proposed v1 producer/consumer protocol before source implementation; schema changes require explicit version change
architecture: Existing _CounterfactualDiffusion pixel-space conditional U-Net; exact local reuse only, not a latent architecture

counterfactual_checkpoint.meaning: Optional existing local diffusion checkpoint. Nonempty means reuse only; no training fallback. Requires generator=diffusion.

counterfactual_checkpoint_sha256.meaning: Expected64hex SHA256 for explicitly selected checkpoint; required when path nonempty, otherwise unused. File picker may compute/pin it at explicit selection, no manual terminal required.

call_protocol._counterfactual_report: Add keyword-only checkpoint=None, checkpoint_sha256=None, input_contract=None. Existing no-checkpoint math/training defaults unchanged.
call_protocol._run_counterfactuals: Optional keyword-only input_contract=None. Forward settings path/hash; pass actual transformed-input contract without altering tensors or normalization.
call_protocol.generate_activation_map: Assemble contract from actual already-resolved transforms and loaded classifier metadata at the existing local seam; no second model resolution/load or preprocessing pass.

payload.state_dict: Restricted tensor mapping; all expected keys/shapes/dtypes finite, strict load; mean/std/abar remain exact saved buffers
payload.config: Existing channels/side/n_classes/width/timesteps/strength/sample_steps/guidance_scale/optional structure_weight config, validated before allocation
payload.levels: Existing exact ordered condition levels, retained for compatibility with current save inspection

input_contract.channel_ids: Nonempty ordered unique source-plane IDs, length equals actual full tensor C. Stored classification RGB planes are labelled as stored plane positions; never invent biological stain names.
input_contract.preprocessing: Canonical JSON mapping of actual pipeline revision, crop_loading_policy, center_crop shape, resolved normalization mean/std or None, selected_channels_1based (zeroing semantics), and classifier-recorded preprocessing. Caller supplies descriptor; backend does not transform crops again.
input_contract.class_labels: Exact nonempty ordered distinct classifier labels from actual classifier artifact metadata or explicit standalone caller contract. Missing labels do not silently acquire biological meaning or legacy compatibility.
input_contract.condition_key: class/plate/well/row/column or explicit standalone declared condition namespace
input_contract.classifier: Backend-computed qualified module/class type and deterministic SHA256 over sorted state_dict key/dtype/shape/exact tensor bytes; no approximate identity
input_contract.code_levels: Exact class-label order for class conditioning; exact sorted source condition strings otherwise. No head reset, remapping or class substitution.

provenance.pretraining_independence: Not inferred from shape or names

producer_rules: Maintain root state_dict/config/levels compatibility; add versioned fields for genuinely described input contracts. Do not backfill historical channel/class provenance from today’s pixels or names.
An ordinary standalone training call without a complete input contract keeps its existing behavior/save inspectability but is not silently certified as reusable under v1.
Actual generated checkpoint SHA is written to report/manifest metadata after serialization; no self-referential hash inside checkpoint.
The reuse branch never rewrites or copies over its selected input checkpoint, even when the report output folder equals the input folder.
consumer_rules: Validate selected kind/path/expected hash/local regular file/size and complete versioned contract before unsafe allocation or model-mode/device mutation. Hold the file descriptor across before/after streamed SHA checks and restricted torch.load(weights_only=True,map_location=cpu). No Python3.11-only file_digest.
Reconstruct only the allowlisted existing U-Net with strict state load; no generic torch_artifacts changes, arbitrary imports, unsafe retry, remote model resolution or network.

Require exact current input/classifier/code contract match; keep saved mean/std and decode schedule. Reject missing/legacy/mismatched metadata, never guess channel correspondence or train replacement weights.
Explicit checkpoint path with autoencoder kind or missing/malformed expected hash refuses before fitting. No checkpoint preserves the existing training route.

Reuse reports actual0 new training epochs, checkpoint SHA/source, and pretraining_independence=unverified unless separately established. Existing score metrics are descriptive, not claimed unseen pretraining validation; do not manufacture history or reconstruction metrics.

ownership.Hard: Existing attribution.py and exact deep_spacr.py forwarding + source-bound backend checks/diagnostics drafts
ownership.Home-B: Actual alpha UI controls/file selection with literal object names, settings persistence/flow/Help and exact normal owner integration

acceptance_limits: Tiny random actual checkpoint validates serialization/inference mechanics only. Genuine compatible checkpoint availability, app-scale known-phenotype/structure/monotonicity evidence and larger latent architecture remain open.
